title: Relative Lattice Bridge
statement: For arbitrary condensed $R$ define the bridge datum from condensed discrete $Z$ actions to the recorded abstract rank-one lattice action category: an exact additive equivalence with underlying-module isomorphism, carrying the positive cyclic generator to the recorded rank-one generator on every generalized section, and an invariant-functor isomorphism fixed by the actual invariant inclusions. Define the canonical functor from the lattice scalar derived localization universe to the smaller scalar Hom-universe localization by the identical Q on complexes, and its localization-unit comparison. A derived bridge is a natural isomorphism from the derived action equivalence followed by the recorded lattice derived invariants and universe transport to the scalar cyclic derived invariants, fixed on EVERY complex by the two computation units and the underived invariant comparison. Define the degree-zero and degree-one projections from the forgotten relative cyclic total of a single module to that actual underlying module. Uses [def-sfb-relative-derived-invariants], [def-sfb-relative-cyclic-total], [lem-sfb-discrete-lattice-koszul-resolution].
